newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SOCCER-SLOVAK-CZECH WORLD CUP MATCH RESCHEDULED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SLOVAK-CZECH WORLD CUP MATCH RESCHEDULED.

text.p: A World Cup qualifier between Slovakia and the Czech Republic has been rescheduled for August 24, the Czech CTK news agency reported on Wednesday.

The European group six World Cup qualifier, originally scheduled for May 21, was postponed because two Czech players -- Radoslav Latal and Jiri Nemec -- are involved in the second leg of the UEFA Cup final with their German club Schalke on the same day.
CTK said an under-21 qualifier between the two nations had been rescheduled for August 23.
